versions.changelog:
- Removed the sample data file track_data.json from the repository.
- No changes to functionality or documentation were made.

Initial release of GPX/KML Route Visualizer.

- Converts GPS track files (KML/GPX) into static JPG route maps or interactive HTML visualizations.
- Parses route coordinates and calculates key statistics (distance, elevation gain/loss).
- Produces high-resolution printable images and browser-based interactive maps with elevation profiles.
- Supports both KML and GPX file formats, including common namespace variants.
- Includes easy workflows and script chaining for quick output generation.
